questions.stem: Thermal radiation is different from conduction and convection because it:

options.text: Requires a fluid to transfer energy
Can travel through a vacuum (empty space)

questions.explanation: Thermal radiation is the transfer of energy by electromagnetic waves (mainly infrared). Unlike conduction and convection, it does not require any material medium and can travel through a vacuum. This is how energy from the Sun reaches Earth.

questions.stem: Which surface is the best emitter and absorber of thermal radiation?
questions.explanation: Dark, matt (dull) surfaces are the best emitters and absorbers of thermal radiation. Light, shiny surfaces are poor emitters and absorbers but good reflectors of radiation.
